messages.snippet: James, Onyx Point Investments Limited is now incorporated (company no. 16204418). Please nominate it
messages.subject: Project Onyx — SPV nomination and funding
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Onyx Point Investments Limited is now incorporated (company no. 16204418). Please nominate it to Marlowe Greaves as the purchaser. Jane confirms the deposit of £1,865,000 will be with you by 12 March, and the completion balance plus SDLT in good time before 7 April.

Tom
